About Lawsuit Funding

Get Financial Relief in 24 hours with Lawsuit Funding

You’ve been struggling through your lawsuit for weeks… months… possibly even years.  In the meantime bills have been piling up and financial obligations are increasing by the minute.  The stress of it all is overwhelming!

You’re stuck between a rock and a hard place. You need cash now but your attorney is fighting a lengthy battle that is meant to get you to settle for less…

Could you imagine how great it would feel to have the financial relief you need tomorrow?  And still give your attorney the time he or she needs to get the full amount of money you deserve from your case? What can you do? Lawsuit funding might be the answer to your questions.

What can lawsuit funding do for you? Think about it for a moment.  With lawsuit funding you have money now that’s yours to use without any restrictions.  You can finally pay off your debts.  You can put it away for your kids’ education.  You can start that business you’ve always dreamed of.  Or you can buy that shiny new car you’ve always wanted … it doesn’t matter!

All the stress and worry is melted away.  You can finally get back to enjoying life to the fullest.

It’s totally possible with lawsuit funding from Multi Funding.

Here’s how Lawsuit Funding works:

Just call 1-866-957-8880 or fill out our no risk, no obligation lawsuit funding review form.  We have representatives ready to assist you. Within 24 hours you can have a Multi Funding Visa card, a check or wire with your funds, based on the future settlement of your case, sent right to you!

There’s NO credit check. There’s NO employment verification. There are NO out of pocket fees. And there are certainly NO monthly payments.

What’s even better is that if you were to lose your case, you won’t have to pay your lawsuit funding back!

Does it really make sense to settle too soon when you can get the cash you need now without any restrictions, payments, fees or obligation to repay if you lose?

Get the financial relief that you desperately deserve today. Call 1-866-957-8880 or submit one of the lawsuit funding forms on this page for a no risk, no obligation funding review.  You have nothing to lose and everything to gain!
